# The Pediatric Dental Team

> A specialized pediatric dental practice in Philadelphia providing comprehensive dental care for children from infancy through adolescence, including preventive care, orthodontics, and emergency services.

The Pediatric Dental Team is a South Philadelphia-based practice staffed with pediatric dentistry specialists who follow American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAPD) guidelines. The practice emphasizes child-centered care, specialized training, and comprehensive services including traditional braces and Invisalign for teens.

- [Child's First Dental Visit](https://www.thepediatricdentalteam.com/childs-first-visit): Guide for child's first dental visit per AAPD recommendations

- [Preschool (3-5 Years)](https://www.thepediatricdentalteam.com/preschool-3-to-5-years): Dental care guide for preschool-aged children ages 3-5
- [Elementary School (6-11 Years)](https://www.thepediatricdentalteam.com/elementary-school-6-to-11-years): Dental care guide for elementary school children ages 6-11
- [Teens & Adolescents](https://www.thepediatricdentalteam.com/dentist-for-teens): Teen dentistry and orthodontics including Invisalign services
